Company Overview

ID.me is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with ID.me once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 152 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with ID.me at 20 federal agencies, 45 state government agencies, and 70+ healthcare organizations. More than 600+ consumer brands use ID.me to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. ID.me’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. ID.me is committed to “No Identity Left Behind” to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/.

ID.me is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At ID.me, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer Intern to join our growing engineering organization at ID.me. As an intern, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful work across a variety of product and platform teams. Whether it's building user-facing features, developing APIs, or strengthening the underlying platform, your work will directly impact millions of users. As an SDE Intern, you'll gain experience working with modern technologies and collaborating with experienced engineers to deliver high-quality solutions in line with this strategy.

This role is based out of our Mountain View, CA office, and requires full-time in-office attendance.

Example Intern Projects You Could Work On

- AI shopping concierge: a conversational AI chat widget for shop.id.me that answers member questions.

- AI Slack agent for Shop Ops: an LLM-driven Slack agent that turns natural-language requests into updates, replacing a manual process.

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and test software components under the guidance of more experienced engineers.

- Contribute to our platform's evolution by developing API-first services used by internal and external teams.

- Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and agile ceremonies to continuously grow your skills.

- Write clear, maintainable, and well-documented code.

- Help troubleshoot issues in development and production environments.

- Learn best practices for software engineering, security, testing, and observability in a platform company, and collaborate with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to ship impactful features.

Minimum Qualifications

- Graduating in 2028 or beyond

- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or related quantitative field.

- Demonstrable proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Java, JavaScript, Go, Python, or Ruby), gained through coursework, internships, or personal projects.

- Strong understanding of basic computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming.

Preferred Qualifications

- Eagerness to learn and take feedback in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

- Familiarity with RESTful APIs and client-server communication.

- Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure through internships or schoolwork.

- Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

- Interest in platform engineering, API design, or building developer tools.

- Exposure to applied AI/LLM development, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, or function/tool-calling — from coursework, internships, hackathons, or personal projects.

- Clear communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

What We Offer

- Intern Schedule: 12 weeks, 40 hours per week, onsite

- Competitive Compensation: $60/h-$70/h base hourly rate

- Start dates for this internship are May & June of 2027

- ID.me may provide a housing stipend payment to eligible students selected for the 2027 Intern Program.

What You'll Gain

- Direct mentorship and regular interaction with an experienced technology team

- Weekly Engineering Onboarding Sessions to gain knowledge and exposure across various teams and product lines

- Practical experience across engineering, product, operations, marketing, and many other verticals

- Meaningful work that can strengthen a future career in consulting, technology, venture capital, or entrepreneurship

- Opportunities to build a professional network within Silicon Valley’s startup and business community

The annual base salary listed does not include a company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity and benefits which will be determined based on experience, skills, education, relevant training, geographic location and role.

ID.me offers comprehensive medical, dental, vision, health savings account, flexible spending accounts (medical, limited purpose, dependent care, commuter benefit accounts), basic and voluntary life and AD&D insurance, 401(k) with company match, parental leave, ability to participate in unlimited paid time off subject to the terms and conditions of the PTO policy, including 8 company wide holidays, short and long-term disability insurance, accident and critical illness insurance, referral bonus policy, employee assistance program, pet insurance, travel assistant program, wellbeing and childcare discounts, benefit advocates, and a learning and development benefit.

Final offers may vary from the amount listed based on qualifications, professional experiences, skills, education, relevant training, geographic location, and other job related factors.

Mountain View, CA Pay Range

$60—$70 USD

ID.me maintains a work environment free from discrimination, where employees are treated with dignity and respect. All ID.me employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling our commitment to equal employment opportunity. ID.me does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. ID.me adheres to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. In addition, ID.me's policy is to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances where a particular employee works. Upon request we will provide you with more information about such accommodations.

Please review our Privacy Policy, including our CCPA policy, at id.me/privacy. If you provide ID.me with any personally identifiable information you confirm that you have read and agree to be bound by the terms and conditions set out in our Privacy Policy.

ID.me participates in E-Verify.

Recommendation algorithm team plays a central role in the company, driving critical product decisions and platform growth. None

Intern

You will use various automated RFID test systems and RFID printer and reader systems. Our co-op program serves as a talent pipeline for our Early Careers Program throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

- Utilizing automated RFID test systems and RFID printer and reader systems to support testing, data collection, data organization, and reporting

- Previous co-op experience

- Volunteerism or similar activities

Requirements:

About bp

bp operates at the heart of the global energy system, helping countries meet their energy needs and serving millions of customers every day. With world-class assets, technology, trading capability, and partnerships, we deliver energy at scale today while investing with discipline in the energy transition.

About the role

As a Finance & Risk Intern, you’ll get hands-on exposure to how bp supports trading activity in fast-moving commodity markets. Finance and Risk help monitor, report, and control the risks connected to trading activity, including market exposure, profit and loss, pricing, and trading controls. You’ll learn how finance and risk teams work with trading benches to understand market movements, explain performance, and help protect bp through strong controls.

During the internship, you’ll build technical and non-technical skills through on-the-job learning, employee-led training sessions, e-learning, mentorship, and project work. You’ll have opportunities to use digital tools, analyze data, ask questions, solve problems, and communicate insights to people across Finance, Risk, and Trading & Shipping.

Successful interns may be considered for a full-time role within our Finance and Risk Graduate Development Program after earning their degree.

What you might do day to day

- Review daily trading activity and help validate exposure, profit and loss, and mark-to-market information.
- Learn how live market volatility impacts trading positions and how teams monitor risk measures such as exposure, stress testing, liquidity, and trading limits.
- Work with data from systems and tools such as Excel, Power BI, and other trading/risk platforms to identify trends, exceptions, or areas for improvement.
- Join conversations with finance and risk colleagues, trading benches, and other supporting teams to understand how commercial decisions are supported and challenged.
- Own a summer project that solves a real business problem, then share your work through a final presentation.

What you’ll build

- A practical understanding of commodity markets, trading activity, financial controls, and risk management
- Confidence working with data, analytics, and digital tools to turn information into useful insight
- Communication and presentation skills through project updates, team discussions, and your final presentation
- A network of peers, mentors, and colleagues across bp’s Finance, Risk, and Trading & Shipping community

One Finance is bp’s early careers program for people starting their finance careers. The program is designed to help early-career professionals build broad experience, develop transferable skills, and grow through challenging assignments, structured learning, and a strong support network. Early-career colleagues joining One Finance may follow one of these tracks: Core Finance, Procurement, or Finance & Risk.

Our internships

Make an impact on cutting-edge projects. Help find solutions to complex challenges. Be part of a company that invests in you and your growth. You can do it all as an intern at bp. Our 12-week summer program gives you the opportunity to build your technical knowledge, develop key skills, and learn more about life at bp. You'll be part of one team throughout your internship, supported by a dedicated line manager and buddy. There’ll be opportunities to connect with other interns, take part in training, and grow your network across the business.

As a bp intern, you can expect:

- A 12-week project-based internship
- A structured performance process, including goal setting, project deliverables, a midpoint check-in, and a final presentation
- A peer mentor to help you transition into bp
- A summer experience that goes beyond the desk, with intern events, team activities, and opportunities to connect with other interns across bp

Benefits

- Retirement savings opportunities
- bp-provided corporate housing with furnished apartments
- Relocation assistance (if eligible)
- Competitive pay
- We pay interns and co-ops a set non-negotiable monthly rate based on your degree major, degree level and year of graduation. For this role, monthly salaries range from $5,313 to $5,625).

- *Please note the pay range listed for this position is a good faith and reasonable estimate of the base pay for this position at the time of posting.

Minimum requirements

- Working toward a bachelor’s degree
- Graduating between December 2027 and May 2028
- Current Cumulative GPA Minimum 3.0
- Eligible to work in the U.S. with no restrictions; bp will not support U.S. immigration sponsorship for full-time or long-term employment
- Must be available to start 12-week internship on May 17, 2027 (will be required to pass all background and medical checks at least one week prior to start date)
- Willing to relocate to Chicago, IL for the duration of the internship

Preferred qualifications

- Interest in commodity markets, trading, finance, analytics, or risk management

Corporate Indianapolis

Simon is looking for a Data Engineering Intern to help build the data models, data pipelines, semantic models and dashboards our business runs on. You'll work alongside data engineers, data scientists and BI developers to turn raw data from marketing, media, leasing, operations into clean, trusted datasets that decision-makers actually use. This is a hands-on data engineering internship. You'll write real SQL, ship real models, and see your work land in front of business stakeholders.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Build data pipelines to connect to and ingest data from various data sources
• Build, enhance, document data models in our Fabric and Snowflake data platforms
• Profile source data, investigate discrepancies, and improve data quality
• Partner with analysts to translate business questions into reusable datasets
• Build/enhance data agents as needed
• Develop and refine dashboards and reports in Power BI as needed
• Present your summer project and findings to the Data & Analytics team

QUALIFICATIONS

• Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, AI, Statistics or a related field
• Working knowledge of SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions)
